result.instructions: Tools for Hosthub, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our rentals have a booking next weekend?"; "List the channels connected to our Lisbon apartment."; "Block the cottage from 12 to 15 December for repairs.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hosthub data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hosthub_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hosthub_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hosthub_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. hosthub_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hosthub_list_rentals
tools.title: List rentals
tools.description: List the rentals (vacation properties) on the account. Each has id, name, city, country, currency, time_zone, and check-in and checkout times. Hosthub API: GET /rentals.

tools.name: hosthub_get_rental
tools.title: Get a rental
tools.description: Get one rental (property) by id: address, currency, time zone, check-in and checkout times, guest capacity, unit count, and preparation days. Hosthub API: GET /rentals/{rentalId}.

rental_id.description: The rental id (from a list or get tool).

tools.name: hosthub_list_rental_channels
tools.title: List channels of a rental
tools.description: List the sales channels (for example Airbnb or Booking.com) connected to one rental. Pages with cursor_gt or cursor_lt. Hosthub API: GET /rentals/{rentalId}/channels.

rental_id.description: The rental id (from a list or get tool).

tools.name: hosthub_list_rate_plans
tools.title: List rate plans of a rental
tools.description: List the rate plans of one rental, with id, name, whether it is the default, and its status (active or inactive). Hosthub API: GET /rentals/{rentalId}/rate-plans.

rental_id.description: The rental id (from a list or get tool).

annotations.title: List rate plans of a rental

tools.name: hosthub_get_rate_plan
tools.title: Get a rate plan
tools.description: Get one rate plan by its encoded id: name, default flag, status, and URL. Hosthub API: GET /rate-plans/{encodedId}.

rate_plan_id.description: The rate plan id (from a list or get tool).

tools.name: hosthub_get_rate_plan_daily_rates
tools.title: Get daily rates of a rate plan
tools.description: Get the daily rates of one rate plan: the price per night for each date the API holds. Hosthub API: GET /rate-plans/{encodedId}/rates.

rate_plan_id.description: The rate plan id (from a list or get tool).

annotations.title: Get daily rates of a rate plan

tools.name: hosthub_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the account (owners and team members) with id, name, email, status, and team role. Hosthub API: GET /users.

tools.name: hosthub_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id: name, email, phone number, status, and team role. Hosthub API: GET /users/{userId}.

user_id.description: The user id (from a list or get tool).

tools.name: hosthub_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List team members with their roles. Filter by role id or rental id. Hosthub API: GET /team-members.

role_id.description: Only members with this role id (role_id_eq).

rental_id.description: Only members with access to this rental id (rental_id_eq).

tools.name: hosthub_list_calendar_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: List calendar events (bookings and holds). With rental_id, list only that rental; without it, list across all rentals. Filter by updated or created integers and visibility. Pages with cursor_gt or cursor_lt. Hosthub API: GET /calendar-events or GET /rentals/{rentalId}/calendar-events.

rental_id.description: Only events of this rental id. Omit for all rentals.

updated_gt.description: Only items with an updated value above this integer (integer filter, as the API documents it).

updated_gte.description: Only items with an updated value at or above this integer (integer filter, as the API documents it).

created_gt.description: Only items with a created value above this integer (integer filter, as the API documents it).

created_gte.description: Only items with a created value at or above this integer (integer filter, as the API documents it).

is_visible.description: Visibility filter: all, true, or false.

tools.name: hosthub_get_calendar_event
tools.title: Get a calendar event
tools.description: Get one calendar event (booking or hold) by id: type, dates, rental and unit, guest details, and money fields. Hosthub API: GET /calendar-events/{calendarEventId}.

calendar_event_id.description: The calendar event id (from a list or get tool).

tools.name: hosthub_list_calendar_event_notes
tools.title: List notes of a calendar event
tools.description: List the internal notes on one calendar event. Hosthub API: GET /calendar-events/{calendarEventId}/notes.

calendar_event_id.description: The calendar event id (from a list or get tool).

annotations.title: List notes of a calendar event

tools.name: hosthub_create_calendar_event
tools.title: Create a booking or hold
tools.description: Create a booking or a hold (a blocked period) for one rental. A booking needs guest details; a hold needs hold_reason. This changes live availability on every connected channel. Hosthub API: POST /rentals/{rentalId}/calendar-events.

rental_id.description: The rental id (from a list or get tool).

type.description: Booking for a guest stay, or Hold to block the dates.

tools.name: hosthub_update_calendar_event
tools.title: Update a calendar event
tools.description: Change the dates, times, guest details, or notes of an existing calendar event. Only the fields you pass change. This can move availability on connected channels. Hosthub API: POST /calendar-events/{calendarEventKey}.

calendar_event_id.description: The calendar event id (from a list or get tool).

tools.name: hosthub_delete_calendar_event
tools.title: Delete a calendar event
tools.description: Delete one calendar event (booking or hold). This changes availability for its dates. Hosthub API: DELETE /calendar-events/{calendarEventId}.

calendar_event_id.description: The calendar event id (from a list or get tool).

tools.name: hosthub_add_calendar_event_note
tools.title: Add a note to a calendar event
tools.description: Add a note to one calendar event. Hosthub API: POST /calendar-events/{calendarEventId}/notes.

calendar_event_id.description: The calendar event id (from a list or get tool).

annotations.title: Add a note to a calendar event
